More than 4 in 10 audited websites had no observable Google Analytics.
Among the 120 websites audited, Google Analytics was not observed on 51 (42.5%) and was observable on 67 (55.8%). Two websites were classified as Unable to Determine.

Almost all audited websites preserved the UTM parameters used during testing.

Among the 120 websites audited, 117 preserved the UTM parameters used during testing. This does not show that these businesses actively use UTMs in their campaigns; it shows that the websites preserved the parameters supplied in the audit.
